about: Dub's shipped daily FX job calls getLatest, answered from the World's exchange-rate facts; the other operations are not demanded and remain in the retained gap.

decisions.why: Demanded calls are recorded in demand.json and remain unserved in the retained gap. Scope is unchanged pending a separate implementation; supplying credentials is not opt-in.
